findings.reason: a subsystem specified without the prior-art search it skipped will be built as a parallel copy, and citing these owners would change what §1 writes.
findings.text: §1 specifies the timing scan step by step (gate duration from the runner's own "in N s" summary, test-command tool calls read from the stream, per-lane median of a per-run fraction) without naming any of the three mechanisms that already do those steps: `_GATE_LOG_DURATION` and `_recorded_gate_seconds` (reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:44, :508), `stream_tool_calls` (reckon/shadow_reads.py:66) with `transcript_tool_blocks` (reckon/velocity.py:1718), and `run_time_profile` (reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py:339)

findings.reason: the plan must extend these owners (or say why they cannot carry a gate-share figure) rather than stand a parallel script beside each, and naming the owners is what makes the finding actionable.
findings.text: §1 proposes to read each gate's own reported duration from its log, but `_recorded_gate_seconds` (reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:508) already reads a run's cited gate log and extracts that duration via `_GATE_LOG_DURATION` (reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:44); the per-lane median-of-a-per-run-fraction §1 asks for is already the shape of `run_time_profile` (reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py:339), which reports median wall time per backend and role over the trailing-window ledger with the missing-is-None-never-zero discipline §1 needs; and §1's stream tool-call extraction is already owned by `stream_tool_calls` (reckon/shadow_reads.py:66, both backend dialects) and `transcript_tool_blocks` (reckon/velocity.py:1718)

findings.reason: a deadline restated in two modules drifts the moment either changes, and the plan should name a single helper for the hard-stop instant so the prompt and the watchdog cannot disagree.
findings.text: §3 states the hard stop as "the launch instant plus the budget times `fences.budget_grace_multiple`" and has `time_fence_statement` (reckon/crew/prompts.py:382) re-derive that instant, but `_apply_budget_watchdog` (reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:333) already computes the same `budget_seconds * grace` threshold that stops the worker, so the one rule has two computations with no shared owner

findings.reason: the plan should either extend the existing owners or justify, in its own text, why a parallel script is the right shape.
findings.text: the new scripts/gate_share_of_run_time.py is a thin read-only layer over the ledger reader (`read_records`, reckon/ledger.py), the stream readers and the gate-log duration parser, and the plan gives no reason those existing mechanisms cannot be extended to carry a gate-share figure

findings.reason: a section that grows the CLI or a public signature must account for the added surface in its own text, and §2's gate verb in particular sits beside the gate-log and budget machinery it would duplicate.
findings.text: §2 proposes a new `reckon crew gate run -- <command>` CLI verb (cli_options 376) and §3 adds a `budget_grace_multiple` parameter to `time_fence_statement` and `compose_prompt` (public_definitions 1869); neither section names what it retires or merges, or states why nothing can be

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the implementable work (§3) is one prompt statement plus one test file; the plan does not spread its complexity across a spread of small wrappers, and the §1 script is a single artefact rather than a family.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan re-implements the gate-log duration parser, the stream tool-call extractor and the per-lane run wall-time profile owned by promotion_gate.py, shadow_reads.py and run_time_profile.py, and re-derives the hard-stop instant recovery_stream.py already computes.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1869, cli_options 376, mcp_views 34, refusal_families 23; §2 proposes a new `reckon crew gate run` CLI verb (cli_options) and §3 widens `time_fence_statement`/`compose_prompt` (public_definitions), neither naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §1 adds scripts/gate_share_of_run_time.py without citing the mechanisms that already parse a gate log's runner duration (reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:44 and :508), extract stream tool calls (reckon/shadow_reads.py:66), or profile per-lane run wall time (reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py:339).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §1 layers a new script over the existing ledger, stream and gate-log readers without saying why those readers cannot be extended.
